name: Coronado National Forest
policyReason: Dogs are allowed almost anywhere, except two areas.
summary: Dogs are allowed almost anywhere, except two areas.

excerpts.quote: Yes, dogs are allowed anywhere in the forest except the Pusch Ridge Wilderness Big Horn Sheep closure area and the Sabino Canyon Recreation Area.

dogRules.text: No dogs in the Pusch Ridge Wilderness bighorn sheep closure area or Sabino Canyon Recreation Area.
Leash required in developed recreation sites; off leash allowed in some situations.
